description: Track what this add-on bundles: Grafana Alloy, the Home Assistant base image, and the GitHub Actions. Actions, the base image and Alloy PATCH releases automerge once CI is green; Alloy minor/major stay PRs, because the AppArmor profile is a list of what the current Alloy touches and a new minor can touch more. A merge only publishes an image - Home Assistant installs it when the operator updates the add-on.

customManagers.description: ALLOY_VERSION in the Dockerfile follows grafana/alloy releases
The add-on version IS the Alloy version, so config.yaml moves with the same release

packageRules.description: One PR per Alloy release, touching Dockerfile and config.yaml together
Alloy patch releases automerge after CI; minor and major wait for a human and a changelog read
Base image tags look like trixie-2026.08.0: track the date part within the trixie line, and automerge - CI rebuilds the image on the PR
GitHub Actions bumps automerge after CI
Pin the builder actions to their release tags, not a floating branch
